FormatId.title: FormatId
FormatId.description: The unique identifier for a format

FormatLength.title: FormatLength
FormatLength.description: The duration of the complete format

FormatName.title: FormatName
FormatName.description: A human readable name for the format

FormatNotes.title: FormatNotes
FormatNotes.description: Additional descriptive information about the format

FormatUsage.title: FormatUsage
FormatUsage.description: Describes which channels and what dates a format can be used

FormatStructure.title: FormatStructure

PrimaryElementId.title: PrimaryElementId
PrimaryElementId.description: A UUID representing a unique identifier for this element

FormatElementType.title: FormatElementType
FormatElementType.description: The type of strucutre for the element such as segment or break

FormatOrderSequence.title: FormatOrderSequence
FormatOrderSequence.description: Indicates the order of each of the format elements (allows placement of comments without indicating an offset time).

AvailNumber.title: AvailNumber
AvailNumber.description: Indicates the position of a break element inside the format structure.

TotalAvails.title: TotalAvails
TotalAvails.description: Indicates the total number of break elements inside the format structure

AuthorizationList.title: AuthorizationList
AuthorizationList.description: Locations that are allowed to use the avail.

IgnoreAvail.title: IgnoreAvail
IgnoreAvail.description: Describes those avails that can be ignored during playback by certain locations

Description.title: Description
Description.description: If the FormatElementType is a Comment then this field is required

FormatStructure.description: A detailed definition of each of the individual elements of the format that include segments, breaks, secondary events and comments.

SubElementSequence.title: SubElementSequence
SubElementSequence.description: The ordinal sequence of each element with in the substructure.

SubElementType.title: SubElementType
SubElementType.description: The type of element as defined in Configuration that is acceptable within the substructure.  Typically strings such as National, Local, but can be any unique definition for the element.

SubElementDuration.title: SubElementDuration
SubElementDuration.description: The expected duration of the subelement.

SubElementCode.title: SubElementCode
SubElementCode.description: A string that defines the type of element or localized code for that element.

SubElementName.title: SubElementName
SubElementName.description: An optional name for the subelement.

SubElementCategory.title: SubElementCategory
SubElementCategory.description: An optional category as defined in Configuration or elsewhere which allows the grouping of the subelements.

NonPrimaryElements.title: NonPrimaryElements
NonPrimaryElements.description: It is possible to add secondary events to a subelement such that one or more events occur at the same time or in overlapping sequence.

FormatSubElements.description: Used to subdivide a format element into smaller structures which when summed in duration would equal the total of the item.

AllowedChannels.description: Channels that a format can be used on

EmbargoDate.title: EmbargoDate
EmbargoDate.description: First date the format can be used

ExpirationDate.title: ExpirationDate
ExpirationDate.description: Last date the format can be used

Exclusions.description: Allows unlimited defined values to be excluded as part of the FormatUsage. (v3.0)

FormatUsage.description: Describes for a format which channels it can be used on

NonPrimaryElementId.title: NonPrimaryElementId
NonPrimaryElementId.description: A UUID representing a unique identification of the element

OffsetTime.title: OffsetTime
OffsetTime.description: The time to start the event relative to the start time of the primary event

NonPrimaryOffset.description: The definition of how a non-primary event should run relative to the primary event either using the start or end points of either event.

PrimaryElementId.title: PrimaryElementId
PrimaryElementId.description: Used to establish a direct linkage to the Primary Element

NonPrimaryElements.description: It is possible to add secondary events to a primary event such that one or more events occur at the same time or in overlapping sequence.
